answer.label: A modern rendering of an ancient anecdote
answer.sourceLine: The ancient account describes a serious talk ignored until Diogenes whistles, then rebukes the listeners. It supplies the story but not the modern phrase about dancing the shimmy; that exact translation was not verified.
